action.objective: Verify e3d4 as the reserved candidate after ...Bh3: does exd4 hold material and king safety?
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search cut off at depth 2, ranking e3d4 191 exact (only candidate with exact bound and largest score). Reserve allows full single-candidate verification. e3d4 captures the d4 pawn, attacks the b8 knight and c6/f5 squares; but it opens the d-file and the Black queen on g2 plus bishops on h3/h4 bear on the king on d1. Need to check for tactical refutation and forced mates before committing.
